files.docs/decision.md:
# Confirmed design decision

The Order Service writes order state and one OrderCreated outbox record in the same storage transaction. Nothing is visible to the dispatcher unless that transaction commits successfully. The dispatcher reads committed records, publishes asynchronously and retries by event ID. A transaction failure rolls back both writes and returns 503. Once durable, the API may return 201 while dispatch remains pending, so keep CON-001 unchanged. Record the invariant as ARC-002 in the Blueprint and update the existing SCN-001 in the Scenario Sequence. The current request authorizes only documentation. A future implementation will require a separate work order.

# Code Review Rules

依据 [已确认蓝图](blueprint.md) ARC-1～4 及 [订单契约](contracts/order.md)。

| 标识 | 设计依据 | 适用条件 | 取证路径 | 违反条件 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CR-001 | Blueprint ARC-1 | 状态写入或 UI／服务调用变更 | ui.mark_paid → order_service.set_status → SQL／commit，核对全部状态写入位置 | ui 直接写订单状态，或绕过服务状态写入口 |
| CR-002 | Blueprint ARC-2；订单契约 | 持久化或异常传播变更 | order_service 写入及 commit，文件数据库第二连接读取，异常传播证据 | 返回成功却未持久化，或数据库异常被转换为成功 |
| CR-003 | Blueprint ARC-3 | src、checks 或 tests 依赖变更 | 正式模块 imports 及运行装配入口 | src 依赖测试运行器、测试身份或夹具配置 |
